question_or_proposition: When 4Q3 is used to determine applicable enforceable numeric discharge limits or compliance comparisons, how should the fact-sheet definition—the lowest four-day average flow rate expected to occur once every three years—be operationalized with respect to the averaging window for the four-day mean, the statistical basis for the three-year recurrence expectation, and which flow (receiving water versus discharge) supplies the value?
required_context: Permit sections that reference 4Q3 in effluent limitation language, limit derivations, or compliance determination methods
Any flow-dependent numeric limit tables or water-quality-based limitation discussions tied to low-flow statistics
notes: The nominated span defines 4Q3, a low-flow statistic used in NPDES limit-setting. Different readings of the four-day averaging method, three-year recurrence criterion, or applicable flow location would change which numeric limit applies under Purpose A if permit obligations reference 4Q3.
